description: Check tokens, pages and x402 payments before your agent trusts them. Offline verdicts.
name: io.github.runningoffcode/wormhole-x402

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Hosted-mode key from dashboard.agentwormhole.com: adds URL checks with change history, and the operator's spend policy (budgets, approvals, kill switch) on payments.
environmentVariables.name: WORMHOLE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Override the hosted verifier endpoint (default https://dashboard.agentwormhole.com/api/v1/verify).
environmentVariables.name: WORMHOLE_VERIFY_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Path to the address-provenance ledger written by wormhole-guard's readguard hook (default ~/.wormhole/addresses.jsonl).
environmentVariables.name: WORMHOLE_ADDRESS_LEDGER

title: Agent Wormhole
